text.p: Spanish-born French film and theater actress Maria Casares has died, French radio and television said on Friday.
Casares died on Thursday on her 74th birthday at her home in the western region of Charente.
She is best remembered for starring in "Les Enfants du Paradis" (Children of Paradise) directed by Marcel Carne who died earlier this month. She also starred in Jean Cocteau's "Orphee".
Casares, born Maria Casares Quiroga, volunteered as a nurse in the Spanish civil war and sought asylum in France after the troops of General Francisco Franco crushed the short-lived Spanish Republic.
